topics.name: Embodied robot navigation and adaptation
topics.summary: Learning-based navigation and behavior cloning are tested in cluttered, unstructured, or changing environments. The results emphasize traversability, embodiment differences, visual tracking, and robustness on physical or game-like tasks.

topics.name: Robot skill learning and manipulation
topics.summary: Visual demonstrations, language instructions, synthetic motion variation, progress signals, and teleoperation support robot skill acquisition. Applications range from grasping and restocking to liquid handling, locomotion, and obstacle-aware manipulation.

topics.name: Physics-guided robotics and deformable dynamics
topics.summary: Physical constraints and learned dynamics models are combined for grasping, deformable-object prediction, tractor simulation, and digital-twin control. The studies report better transfer and extrapolation when contact, material, or system structure is represented explicitly.

topics.name: World-model and long-horizon robot control
topics.summary: Latent dynamics, imagined rollouts, kinematic evaluation, and revisable trajectories address coordination over extended embodied tasks. The recurring concern is retaining feasible behavior when histories, morphology, and action consequences become difficult to model.

topics.name: Safe autonomous planning for aerial and multi-robot systems
topics.summary: Distributed planning, predictive control, barrier filtering, and mixed-integer coordination handle collision risk, spoofed sensing, workload coupling, and changing task assignments. Evaluations span aerial vehicles, robot teams, subsea operations, and constrained scheduling.

topics.name: Autonomous driving perception and coordination
topics.summary: Closed-loop driving systems combine generated safety scenarios, cooperative features, temporal lane-graph association, and adaptive expert routing. The common objective is stable road understanding and safer decisions under changing traffic context.

topics.name: Reliable LLM reasoning and test-time computation
topics.summary: Reasoning quality is improved through process checks, outcome-based supervision, rollback, distillation, and selective consultation of stronger models. Evaluations across puzzles, coding, mathematics, and open-ended tasks show gains from targeted computation rather than uniform extra decoding.

topics.name: Language-agent memory, planning, and tool use
topics.summary: Tool selection, searchable interaction logs, state coverage, causal prompts, and asynchronous policy training support agents over extended workflows. Results show that memory organization and explicit state changes can improve sparse-feedback behavior while adding latency and coordination costs.

topics.name: Retrieval, search, and document intelligence
topics.summary: Retrieval-augmented systems use clarification, evidence checks, schema routing, OCR, and structured extraction for conversational, financial, and enterprise documents. Benchmarks expose failures from weak grounding, layout variation, vocabulary drift, and incorrect entity relations.

topics.name: LLM behavioral, cultural, and self-report evaluation
topics.summary: Controlled benchmarks, surveys, persona simulations, value dilemmas, and self-report inventories examine alignment across cultures, social settings, and claims about inner experience. The findings show that framing, language, and post-training shape judgments that aggregate accuracy misses.

topics.name: Formal and computational language reasoning
topics.summary: Logical, paraconsistent, neuro-symbolic, and formula-aware methods test how language models handle chained dependencies and structured evidence. Results favor explicit representations and targeted supervision, while revealing shortcut behavior on long or inconsistent inputs.

topics.name: LLM security and adversarial robustness
topics.summary: Black-box probing, activation interventions, attack ensembles, cache isolation, refusal testing, and supply-chain audits expose model and agent weaknesses. The papers show that robustness depends on both internal representations and surrounding execution or data pipelines.

topics.name: Cybersecurity agents and responsible automation
topics.summary: Security-focused agents are evaluated for malware analysis, offensive capability, evidence-grounded teamwork, and ethical misuse risks. The recurring design requirements are auditable evidence, restricted execution, accountability, and separation between analysis and harmful action.

topics.name: Runtime assurance and safety monitoring
topics.summary: Runtime monitors convert clinical constraints, trajectory forecasts, physical checks, and domain-specific rules into pre-action safeguards. Applications include hospital systems, optical networks, and other settings where detecting risk before execution is more valuable than repairing failure afterward.

topics.name: Efficient LLM training and systems
topics.summary: Profiler-guided optimization, NPU parallelism, low-rank allocation, compact training stacks, and accelerator-kernel benchmarking address the cost of adapting and deploying language models. Results emphasize search overhead, portability, batching, and reproducibility alongside raw throughput.

topics.name: Efficient attention and neural memory
topics.summary: Local-global attention, head-specific caching, writable recurrent memory, and residual routing reduce computation while preserving long-context information. Architectural experiments show that memory placement and compression choices strongly affect optimization and sequence quality.

topics.name: Model compression for low-cost inference
topics.summary: Quantization, structured pruning, cumulative-sum temporal layers, and edge-oriented inference reduce memory, energy, or latency across language, speech, vision, and aviation applications. Task-aware calibration is needed to retain the signals that drive downstream accuracy.

topics.name: Diffusion generative modeling and image editing
topics.summary: Denoising schedules, quantum-inspired filtering, few-step language generation, cache-aware visuomotor diffusion, and multimodal image translation improve sampling efficiency or fidelity. The applications include thermal faces, video edits, garments, and structured generation under tight budgets.

topics.name: Long-video generation and restoration
topics.summary: Memory-writing supervision, cross-frame conditioning, motion synthesis, and efficient restoration support identity and layout over extended video. Experiments target minute-scale extrapolation, deblurring, and edits under capture conditions absent from training.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction and view-consistent editing
topics.summary: Progressive stereo generation, Gaussian primitives, multi-view label propagation, camera-aware completion, and code-native asset construction recover geometry and preserve edits across viewpoints. The methods trade detail, speed, and consistency for difficult views and partial observations.

topics.name: Audio understanding and music generation
topics.summary: Temporal self-play, hierarchical token planning, flow-based synthesis, and rhythm-pitch structure support both fine-grained audio reasoning and long-form music creation. Evaluations focus on perceptual timing, song-level coherence, and controllable melodic structure.

topics.name: Federated, decentralized, and edge learning
topics.summary: Federated optimization, consensus over private feature partitions, gradient coding, Riemannian updates, and analytic medical-image aggregation distribute learning under communication and privacy constraints. The studies emphasize drift stability, heterogeneity, and reduced dependence on centralized deep models.

topics.name: Causal effect estimation and discovery
topics.summary: Causal forests, poisoning audits, latent-variable graph learning, and autoregressive edge discovery estimate effects or structure when rollout timing, selection, and contaminated records complicate inference. The common focus is identifying which relationships remain reliable under imperfect data.

topics.name: Online and risk-sensitive decision-making
topics.summary: Regret guarantees, Bayesian expert aggregation, active inference, counterfactual utility scoring, and nonstationary feedback loops support decisions without fixed horizons or known dynamics. Applications include trading, ranking, enterprise planning, and adaptive control.

topics.name: Network and time-series forecasting
topics.summary: Forecasting foundation models, expert-guided trajectory editing, domain-adapted power curves, spectral filtering, and spatiotemporal architectures address irregularity, drift, missing observations, and feedback. Benchmarks span agriculture, energy, networks, wearables, and satellite-derived environmental measurements.

topics.name: Robust statistical learning and distribution shift
topics.summary: Kernel approximations, fuzzy and imbalanced regression, discrepancy tests, clustering validation, matrix factorization, and domain reweighting improve learning under rare cases or mismatched distributions. Theoretical analyses connect robustness to geometry, calibration, and data-dependent validity.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning and optimization
topics.summary: Quantum kernels, variational circuits, FPGA execution, noisy photonic networks, and compact configuration-interaction models are compared under hardware and resource limits. Results stress fair classical baselines and distinguish implementation noise from useful task signal.

topics.name: Physics-informed scientific machine learning
topics.summary: Equation residuals, constitutive structure, spectral representations, and learned surrogates support simulation or inference for fluids, orbital systems, particle data, polymers, nanopore signals, and materials. Gains include stability, label efficiency, uncertainty handling, and better physical extrapolation.

topics.name: Clinical segmentation and lesion analysis
topics.summary: Weak supervision, domain-shift diagnostics, interactive refinement, lesion-specific detection, and privacy-preserving synthesis address limited labels and deployment constraints in medical images. Evaluations emphasize localization quality, transfer across datasets, and robustness to corrupted inputs.

topics.name: MRI diagnosis, reconstruction, and quantitative imaging
topics.summary: Sequence selection, active acquisition, super-resolution, implicit signal models, intensity normalization, and multimodal fusion improve spine, knee, cardiac, fetal, and diffusion MRI. The recurring trade-off is recovering diagnostic detail while handling scanner variation, motion, and undersampling.

topics.name: Clinical robustness of medical imaging
topics.summary: Cross-site testing, anatomy-aware fusion, radiogenomics, uncertainty reporting, and feature-distribution calibration reveal failures hidden by source-domain scores. The evidence covers brain, lumbar, capsule, mammography, and cancer imaging under degradation and reconstruction changes.

topics.name: Pain and physiological sensing
topics.summary: Facial video, fNIRS, physiological signals, wearable uncertainty estimates, and inter-body garment sensing provide complementary evidence for pain, gaze, and caregiving-related states. Results favor multimodal cues for detection but show localization and confidence remain difficult.

topics.name: EEG processing and rehabilitation assessment
topics.summary: Artifact labeling, synthetic motor-imagery augmentation, phase-aware movement modeling, and narrative EEG markers support assisted clinical assessment. Experiments emphasize user transfer, boundary accuracy, and cautious interpretation of generated or noisy neural signals.

topics.name: Video perception and action understanding
topics.summary: Tracking pipelines use reactive analysis, target-aware memory, multi-camera association, temporal compression, and action-specific experts. Benchmarks cover RGB-thermal streams, indoor people tracking, surgery, listener response, and open-world anomalies under appearance or viewpoint changes.

topics.name: Remote-sensing and multimodal visual perception
topics.summary: Cross-view retrieval, visible-infrared fusion, off-nadir benchmarks, point-cloud adaptation, building mapping, urban inspection, and cloud-gap reconstruction improve geospatial perception. Results target robustness to sensor, season, resolution, geometry, and missing-data shifts.

topics.name: Speech, speaker, and biometric recognition
topics.summary: Speech geolocation, anonymization analysis, speaker verification, iris recognition, and multimodal biometric fusion study identity under noise, pose, illumination, and representation changes. Feature complementarity improves error rates, but quality varies by sensing modality.

topics.name: Spiking and energy-efficient vision
topics.summary: Event-like membrane dynamics, sparse trajectory modeling, and cross-modal spike integration support tracking and infrared-visible fusion with reduced parameters or energy. The evaluations show that sparsity can preserve weak visual evidence when temporal structure is modeled carefully.

topics.name: Embedding-based retrieval and dataset diagnostics
topics.summary: Embedding geometry is used to measure corpus diversity, multimodal alignment, and similarity-search limits. The methods reveal that aggregate retrieval scores can conceal clustering, label, or dimensionality failures and provide diagnostics for model and dataset design.

topics.name: Acoustic sensing and localization
topics.summary: Time-varying acoustic features estimate biological conditions and source position in noisy or changing environments. Applications include beehive monitoring and shape-changing microphone arrays on robots, with emphasis on temporal modulation and spatial reconstruction.

topics.name: Social behavior and media analysis
topics.summary: Reply networks, emotional aftereffects, bias framing, and political collective behavior are analyzed with sequence models, visual explanations, and social-context measures. The findings separate influence or predictive accuracy from faithful explanations and human judgments.

topics.name: Knowledge graphs and relation extraction
topics.summary: Dependency graphs, relational representations, probabilistic rules, and structured graph construction support historical entity linking, domain reasoning, and specialized graph analysis. The recurring benefit is making implicit relations auditable rather than relying only on dense embeddings.

topics.name: Recruitment and low-resource NLP
topics.summary: Hiring benchmarks, fairness-aware applicant representations, literary corpora, lexical simplification, occupation coding, and culturally loaded translation address language variation and demographic leakage. The studies pair compact resources with audits of transfer, matching, and human usefulness.

topics.name: Selective specialist models
topics.summary: Confidence, disagreement, and abstention signals route inputs among lightweight specialists for sentiment, tabular completion, alarm triage, and ensemble reasoning. Selective computation improves cost or reliability when ambiguous cases are concentrated rather than processed uniformly.

topics.name: Human-AI interaction, work, and education
topics.summary: User studies examine preference revision, interactive narratives, workplace substitution, talent retention, and culturally different judgments of AI-assisted learning. Results show that engagement, trust, perceived responsibility, and organizational context shape adoption beyond model capability.

topics.name: Scientific and molecular structure reasoning
topics.summary: Spectroscopy, crystal auditing, antibody design, OLED generation, and materials prediction combine learned representations with geometry, connectivity, sequence, or mechanistic constraints. The shared aim is producing chemically plausible candidates and explanations that can be checked against domain structure.

topics.name: AI-assisted electronic design and software repair
topics.summary: Language models, graph-based CAD representations, defect prediction, test prioritization, repair agents, and cross-model code review support engineering workflows. Reliable systems combine generated artifacts with connectivity checks, iterative tests, and deterministic validation.

topics.name: AI in arts and creative practice
topics.summary: Style metrics, artist judgments, workshop interventions, interactive theater generation, and critical accounts of machine creativity examine both creative output and practitioner control. The evidence favors multidimensional evaluation and human-centered explanation over a single quality score.

topics.name: Generative AI and cultural information markets
topics.summary: Studies of library referrals, synthetic publishing, freight-market mediation, and economy-wide usage map how generative systems alter visibility, supply, revenue, and competition. Effects depend on access, linking, platform design, and the distribution of decision authority.

topics.name: Mechanistic interpretability and neural failure analysis
topics.summary: Activation probes, causal interventions, spectral diagnostics, representation geometry, and exact architectural analyses test whether learned features support faithful computation. The results identify hidden correlations, unstable mechanisms, and failures that output confidence alone does not reveal.

topics.name: Machine-assisted data curation and clinical workflows
topics.summary: Knowledge-graph context, realistic corruption models, biomedical annotation ranking, and HIPAA-aware laboratory systems help experts find and repair structured-data errors. Human review remains central while automated systems prioritize anomalies and coordinate downstream workflow steps.

topics.name: Trustworthy multimodal clinical learning
topics.summary: Concept bottlenecks, anatomy-aware regions, modality reliability, and calibration improve clinical predictions from ultrasound and multi-omics inputs. Evaluation combines discrimination with spatial faithfulness, robustness to degraded channels, and interpretable confidence.

topics.name: Data visualization and graph layout
topics.summary: Intermediate languages and task-oriented layout methods make complex visual structures easier to generate, inspect, and compare. The work links graph bundling with programmable visualization representations that preserve semantics for downstream rendering and analysis.

topics.name: Sequential recommendation and ranking
topics.summary: Long inactivity, unified sequential modeling, explainable transaction states, and heterogeneous recommendation graphs are handled with frozen-backbone gates, feature interactions, and relation-aware objectives. Results focus on recovering personalization when observations are sparse or structurally uneven.

topics.name: Risk governance and socio-technical systems
topics.summary: Complex-risk theory, social epistemology, consensus design, and simulation-based influence analysis study how technical systems interact with institutions and collective behavior. The recurring recommendation is pluralistic, auditable governance that treats uncertainty and feedback as first-class concerns.
